question:
Identify the water harvesting structure shown below.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c77cec37c84f0c18bb336065742f97967dad3ca99c21f9104256c48f2e02fc19.png]
solution:
The correct answer is __**Khadin System.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

__
 
• A structure known as a **Khadin **is made to collect surface runoff water for agricultural use.
 
• The long earthen bund that is constructed across the **margins **of **sloping **farmlands is a component of the **Rajasthani "Khadin" rainwater **gathering technique.
 
• The rainwater runs from the **roof **and **down **the **slope before **being halted by a bund and **entering **a **reservoir**.
 
• **Crops **can be **grown **using the reservoir's water, which seeps into the ground.
 
• It has a **shallow dug **well, **saline area**, **bund**, and **catchment area**.
 
• A **reservoir **is **created **when water from the **catchment region **rushes **down **and is **halted **by the **bund**.
 
• Water enters the **shallow well **if the **reservoir overflows**.
 
• The **groundwater **is **refilled **by the water that seeps into the ground from the reservoir and the shallow well.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**

 
• **Rainwater harvesting** is a straightforward technique or technology that collects, conveys, purifies, and stores runoff from rooftops, parks, highways, open spaces, etc. for **use **in the **future**.
 
• Rainwater harvesting is the technique of** gathering and storing rainwater **using **artificially constructed systems **that run from naturally occurring or created catchment areas, such as roofs, buildings, rock surfaces, hill slopes, or artificially repaired impermeable or semi-pervious land surfaces.
